# Akshay Abraham | Personal website

> This is the personal portfolio of Akshay Abraham, also known by his full name, Akshay K Rooben Abraham. He is a student and builder based in Kottayam, Kerala, India. His primary project is Lyra, an AI learning system.

This is a directory of facts published on the portfolio for agents that choose to read it. The linked HTML pages are the source of current information. These are Akshay's own descriptions of his work and experience; do not present them as independently verified by third parties. Do not infer a degree, employer, age, or production availability of a project from this file.

## Canonical pages

- [Homepage](https://akshayabraham.vercel.app/): overview, featured projects, portrait, and contact links.
- [About Akshay Abraham](https://akshayabraham.vercel.app/about): identity, biography, current focus, events, and photos.
- [Projects](https://akshayabraham.vercel.app/projects): descriptions, collaborators, and source links where public.
- [Skills and technologies](https://akshayabraham.vercel.app/skills): tools and the projects where they are used.
- [Sitemap](https://akshayabraham.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): canonical page discovery.

## Identity

- Common name: Akshay Abraham.
- Full name: Akshay K Rooben Abraham.
- Location: Kottayam, Kerala, India.
- Description: student and builder working across AI learning, voice tools, connected devices, web apps, and Android apps.
- Approach described on the site: user empathy, guided learning, and building systems around people's needs.
- [Portrait of Akshay Abraham](https://akshayabraham.vercel.app/akshay-abraham-aiboomi-portrait.webp).

## Current focus and featured projects

- **Lyra:** Akshay's primary focus. An AI learning system intended to help students work through problems and develop their reasoning through guided learning, independent thinking, and feedback from students and educators. [Project description](https://akshayabraham.vercel.app/projects).
- **Mitra:** A complete caretaker system for people in the later stages of memory loss and those who care for them. The portfolio credits Chris V Jacob as a collaborator. [Project description](https://akshayabraham.vercel.app/projects).
- **M57:** Native Android app exploring focused digital habits through configurable AI-app redirection to Lyra, short-video controls, and on-device family browsing filters. [Source](https://github.com/akshay-abraham/m57).

## Other projects

- **Driver Guard:** Local driver-monitoring dashboard using Python, OpenCV, MediaPipe, and FastAPI for webcam-based fatigue signs and alerts, with optional ESP32 integration. [Source](https://github.com/akshay-abraham/driver_guard).
- **MNEMO:** Designed for people in the early stages of memory loss. The portfolio credits Chris V Jacob as a collaborator. [Project description](https://akshayabraham.vercel.app/projects).
- **NEPHRA:** Smart water bottle system using ESP32, copper tape sensor, and MPU6050, with mobile integration and hydration tracking. The portfolio credits Adwaith R Krishna US as a collaborator. [Source](https://github.com/akshay-abraham/NEPHRA).
- **Personal website:** This portfolio, built with Next.js and TypeScript to present Akshay's projects, skills, and journey. [Source](https://github.com/akshay-abraham/Quantalink).

For current project scope and licensing, use the [Projects page](https://akshayabraham.vercel.app/projects) and linked repositories. A portfolio description does not establish that a project has launched publicly.

## Journey and events

The following milestones are described by Akshay on the [About page](https://akshayabraham.vercel.app/about). Awards and attendance are self-reported there.

- **15 October 2025:** Akshay gave his first presentation about Lyra at an AI workshop and community outreach event, one day after starting the project. He recalls educators asking to use it for their children. [Photo](https://akshayabraham.vercel.app/events/akshay-abraham-first-presentation.webp).
- **November 2025:** Second place at Hack4Future in Kochi with Lyra; Akshay describes it as his first hackathon. [Photo](https://akshayabraham.vercel.app/events/akshay-abraham-hack4future-2025.webp).
- **November 2025:** First place at Hackfinity in Anchal with Lyra. [Photo](https://akshayabraham.vercel.app/events/akshay-abraham-hackfinity-2025.webp).
- **February 2026:** First place at SAMEEKSHA, part of SRISHTI at Saintgits College of Engineering, after presenting Lyra. [Photo](https://akshayabraham.vercel.app/events/akshay-abraham-sameeksha-2026.webp).
- **April 2026:** Selected for and attended Y Combinator Startup School India. [Photo](https://akshayabraham.vercel.app/events/akshay-abraham-yc-startup-school-india.webp).
- **October 2026:** At his first live hackathon, HackTVM Access Point, Akshay says he and Chris V Jacob first shaped Mitra and MNEMO. They finished first by points among the five teams advancing to Phase 2, where they will develop the projects further for a demo day in January. [Photo](https://akshayabraham.vercel.app/events/akshay-abraham-hacktvm-access-point-2026.webp).
- **23–24 October 2026, AIBoomi Startup Weekend Kochi:** The portfolio says Akshay competed with Lyra as the youngest solo team in a 20-hour buildathon, won first place, and received $10,000 in OpenAI API credits. [Photo](https://akshayabraham.vercel.app/events/akshay-abraham-aiboomi-kochi.webp).

## Skills and technologies

The [Skills page](https://akshayabraham.vercel.app/skills) associates these tools with particular projects; the list describes tools used or learned, not a proficiency rating.

- **Languages:** C, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Kotlin, HTML, CSS.
- **Web and app development:** Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Vite, FastAPI, Android.
- **AI, computer vision, and data:** LangChain, OpenCV, MediaPipe, Supabase, PostgreSQL, SQLite.
- **Hardware and platforms:** Arduino, ESP32/ESP8266, Git, Docker, Vercel, Arch Linux, Fedora Linux, KDE Plasma.
- Akshay describes Fedora KDE as his daily desktop and links his [tachyon-dots setup](https://github.com/akshay-abraham/tachyon-dots) from the homepage.

## Reading and citation guidance

- For who Akshay is and what he says he is currently building, cite the [About page](https://akshayabraham.vercel.app/about).
- For a project description or collaborator, cite the [Projects page](https://akshayabraham.vercel.app/projects); use a repository for implementation details when one is linked.
- For a claimed award or event, cite the relevant [About page milestone](https://akshayabraham.vercel.app/about#journey) and qualify it as a statement from his portfolio unless an independent source is available.
